cross_paper.question: Compare the attention mechanism in Attention Is All You Need with the low-rank updates in the LoRA paper.

response.answer:
The model did not validate a synthesized comparison. Exact source excerpts:

Attention Is All You Need (PDF p. 2): In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead
relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.

LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models (PDF p. 4): This means that when
applying LoRA to all weight matrices and training all biases2, we roughly recover the expressive-
ness of full ﬁne-tuning by setting the LoRA rank r to the rank of the pre-trained weight matrices.
